Name: Pelican Packs A Stardew Valley Trading Card Experience
Author: Corbin8223
Description:
# 🐦 Pelican Packs

**Pelican Packs** adds cozy collectible card packs to Stardew Valley — with satisfying pack openings, rarity-based pulls, collection tracking, duplicate selling, achievements, NPC reactions, milestone mail, and lightweight questlines.

The idea is simple: give you another relaxing thing to collect, open, and work toward during everyday farm life.

Crack open a pack after a long day on the farm, chase that rare glow, sell your duplicates, and slowly build your Pelican card collection one pull at a time.

---

## 🎨 Important Note About Card Art

The current card artwork is **AI-generated placeholder/prototype art**.

I would love to eventually replace the cards with handmade pixel art or commissioned artwork that better matches Stardew Valley’s style. I just have not found an artist yet who can remake the full card set.

For now, the AI-generated cards are being used so the gameplay systems, collection loop, pack openings, achievements, quests, and progression can continue to grow and be tested.

---

## ✨ What It Adds

- 📦 Collectible **Pelican card packs**
- 🃏 Interactive pack opening animations
- 👆 Click-to-reveal card flips
- ⭐ Card rarities:
  - Common
  - Uncommon
  - Rare
  - Epic
  - Legendary
- 📖 A Collection menu to track discovered and owned cards
- 📦 Bulk pack opening for opening multiple packs at once, up to 10
- 💰 Duplicate card selling at Pierre’s shop
- 🏆 Achievement tracking and rewards
- 🔔 Achievement unlock notifications
- 💬 NPC flavor dialogue
- ✉️ NPC milestone mail rewards
- 📜 Lightweight Pelican Packs questlines
- ✅ Quest notifications and a dedicated Quest Log
- ⌨️ Configurable keyboard controls
- 🎮 Optional controller bindings
- ⚙️ Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support

---

## 🛒 How To Get Packs

Pelican Packs are sold through existing shops:

- 🏪 **Pierre** sells Pelican Starter Packs and Pelican Spring Packs.
- 🎣 **Willy** sells Pelican Fishing Packs.

Open packs from your inventory using the configured pack-opening key. If you have more than one of the same pack, you can choose how many to open.

You can open packs one at a time for the full reveal experience, or bulk open multiple packs when you want to move faster.

---

## 🎮 Default Controls

- **K** opens the Collection menu.
- **P** opens a held Pelican Pack or the pack choice menu.
- At Pierre’s shop, the collection shortcut opens the duplicate selling menu.
- Achievements and Quest Log can be opened from the Collection menu.
- Achievements and Quest Log also have configurable keybinds, but they are unbound by default.

Controls can be changed in `config.json`, or through **Generic Mod Config Menu** if it is installed.

---

## 🏆 Progression

Pelican Packs includes a progression system that tracks:

- Packs opened
- Cards pulled
- Unique cards collected
- Rare, Epic, and Legendary pulls
- Duplicates sold
- Gold earned from duplicate sales

Achievements unlock once, grant small rewards, and can be viewed in the Achievements menu.

The rewards are meant to feel useful without flooding the player with too many free packs too early.

---

## 💬 NPCs, Mail, and Quests

Pelican Packs now has light town integration.

Several Stardew Valley villagers can react to your card collecting progress, including:

- 🛒 Pierre
- ⚔️ Abigail
- 🔮 Wizard
- 🎸 Sam
- 🖤 Sebastian
- 🌸 Jas
- 🧢 Vincent

As your collection grows, some NPCs may send milestone letters with small rewards. Questlines are introduced through mail and give you simple collecting goals, such as:

- Selling duplicate cards
- Pulling rare cards
- Finding stronger rarity pulls
- Expanding your collection

These are meant to be small Stardew-style goals that make the card system feel connected to the town.

---

## 🔧 Compatibility

Pelican Packs is built for **SMAPI** and is designed to avoid replacing vanilla content directly.

It adds its own:

- Objects
- Menus
- Mail entries
- Shop items
- Progression data
- Quest tracking

**Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.** 
If it is not installed, the mod will still work normally using `config.json`.

Pelican Packs should work with most mods, though heavy UI/menu mods may need extra testing.

---

## ⚙️ Installation

1. Install the latest version of **SMAPI**.
2. Download **Pelican Packs**.
3. Extract the Pelican Packs folder into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
4. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

You’re good to go. 🎉

---

## 🔮 Future Plans

Planned or possible additions include:

- More pack types
- More card sets
- More NPC flavor and progression content
- More collection polish
- Better handmade/custom card art if an artist becomes available
- Expanded gameplay systems later

**Card battles are still only a future idea.** 
They are not part of the current version.

---

## 🧩 Content Pack Support

Pelican Packs now supports external content packs. Add-on creators can add their own cards, packs, pack images, card images, rarity weights, and shop placement through JSON files inside the `ContentPacks` folder.

This means Pelican Packs can now be expanded with custom card sets without editing the core mod code. A `ContentPackGuide.txt` is included for anyone interested in making add-ons.

---

## 🌟 Final Note

Pelican Packs is meant to be cozy, collectible, and satisfying without taking over the game.

Open a few packs, chase some rare pulls, sell your duplicates, and enjoy another little thing to look forward to during your Stardew day.

If you enjoy the mod, an endorsement is always appreciated. 💛
